### 99-usb-backup.rules
# USB Backup: start a backup when a registered disk is plugged in.
ACTION=="add", SUBSYSTEM=="block", ENV{ID_FS_UUID}=="A41C-77E2", TAG+="systemd", ENV{SYSTEMD_WANTS}+="usb-backup@A41C-77E2.service"
ACTION=="add", SUBSYSTEM=="block", ENV{ID_FS_UUID}=="0f3c1e2a-9b8d-4c7e-a6f5-112233445566", TAG+="systemd", ENV{SYSTEMD_WANTS}+="usb-backup@0f3c1e2a-9b8d-4c7e-a6f5-112233445566.service"

### usb-backup@.service
[Unit]
Description=USB Backup to the disk with file system UUID %I

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/usb-backup-cli run --quiet-skip --wait 30
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
Nice=10
IOSchedulingClass=idle
TimeoutStartSec=12h
